retrievalProfile.description: A central luxury watch with a diamond bezel containing a photographic scene inside the dial, set against a textured fabric background.

recipe.visualDefinition: A large, gold-toned luxury watch with a diamond-encrusted bezel dominates the center. The watch face acts as a window into a domestic scene. The entire object is set against a deep blue, rippled silk or satin background.
coreVisualRelationships: The watch face serves as a frame for the internal photographic subject.
The gold and diamond textures contrast with the soft, rippled blue fabric.
Bold display typography is layered over the top of the watch case.
The watch hands are positioned over the internal scene to maintain the watch identity.
coreInvariants: A circular diamond-set bezel framing a central image.
A gold link bracelet extending vertically from the watch head.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The watch is centered and occupies approximately 80% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The circular watch face with the diamond bezel.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bold top text, move down into the watch face scene, and follow the gold bracelet downward.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The deep blue rippled fabric provides textured negative space on the left and right sides.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Gold and metallic tones of the watch.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep royal blue of the background fabric.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White and blue highlights in the typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the bright, reflective gold/diamonds and the dark, saturated blue background.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses ultra-bold, wide sans-serif characters with thick blue outlines.
Secondary text uses a slanted, high-contrast formal script.
Internal watch text uses small, spaced-out capital letters.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The hyphen in the main title is stylized as a thick block.
Script letters feature elongated, sharp swashes.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold industrial sans-serif paired with elegant traditional script for a 'street-luxury' contrast.

preserve: Blue and white color scheme for text
The contrast between blocky and script fonts

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed weight of the primary display text.
Captures the formal, high-contrast script style of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-detail 3D render of a gold luxury watch with a diamond bezel and gold link bracelet, centered on a rippled royal blue silk background. The watch face should be a clear glass window showing a person in a kitchen scene.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply bold, wide white sans-serif text with a thick blue stroke at the top. Below it, add a blue calligraphic script title with a thin white outline, slightly overlapping the top of the watch face.

verificationChecks: Is the watch bezel encrusted with diamonds?
Is the background a rippled blue fabric?
Is the primary text ultra-bold with a blue outline?
Is there a script font layered over the watch face?

mustAchieve: Clear hierarchy between text and watch
Rich texture in the background fabric

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the watch hands are visible over the internal image.
Check that the diamond bezel has a distinct 'sparkle' effect.
Verify the blue fabric has realistic highlights and shadows.
Confirm the text outlines are sharp and consistent.
recipe.reuseFormula: Luxury Object + Internal Scene + Rippled Fabric Backdrop + High-Contrast Typographic Pairing
